description: Euro reference rates straight from the ECB (Android EcbRates.kt / iOS EcbRates.swift). round5: value to 5 significant digits, half up, computed as floor(v x 10^k + 0.5) / 10^k with k = 4 - floor(log10 v) (k < 0: floor(v / 10^-k + 0.5) x 10^-k); values <= 0 or not finite unchanged. cross(day, base, quote): units of quote per 1 base from the euro rates of one day (EUR = 1); base EUR = the ECB value unchanged, any other base = round5(quote / base); null if a side is missing, not > 0 or base == quote. rebase(day, base): cross for every code of the day plus EUR, base itself excluded. parseXml: eurofxref-daily.xml / -hist-90d.xml / -hist.xml, day -> code -> rate, only three-letter A-Z codes with a finite rate > 0, 'only' keeps just those codes, null without a readable day or with DOCTYPE/ENTITY. parseSdmx: ECB Data Portal format=jsondata&detail=dataonly (CURRENCY dimension from structure.dimensions.series, dates from structure.dimensions.observation[0]), empty body = {} (no rates in the range), unreadable = null. recent(days, windowDays): the days on or after newest - windowDays, ascending (expected lists the dates). seriesUrl: codes without EUR, distinct, sorted, joined with +. coveredByHist90d: from >= today - 80 days. Numbers compared with relative tolerance 1e-12 (both platforms use the same IEEE operations; the tolerance only absorbs JSON number parsing).
